chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Awrama, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥassān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام
about the saying of Allah, the Exalted: “There, the wilayah belongs to Allah, the True.”
He عليه السلام said: “The wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh; Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn; the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, to Whom true authority belongs
key_terms.الْحَقِّ: the True; describing Allah in the verse
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةُ: wilayah; authority and divinely established guardianship in the context of the verse
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah; indicating the Qur'anic verse being explained

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explain the verse “There, the wilayah belongs to Allah, the True”?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the verse as referring to wilayah in connection with Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It is a concise example of Qur'anic commentary in which the Imam عليه السلام explains the verse through the doctrine of divinely appointed authority.
